name: Safira Svetlaya
source:
After our meeting, I couldn't help asking my [url=https://vndb.org/c144568]mother[/url] who the woman was. She told me that Safira had once been her commander — she had led Eva and the others and been responsible for them. But everything changed when my mother kidnapped Eva's body: Safira felt betrayed and came to hate her.

[In game description]
